note: The same hop-back path as the warrior's, the mage's and the Rogue's dodge, with a small extra lift (y, in frame widths: 0.02 and 0.025 of a 512 px frame add about 10 and 13 px) because the Cleric's drawn hop is a short heavy one (his boots are 46 and 7 px up on frames 3 and 4, the Rogue's 57 and 11, the mage's 73 and 33). x: character widths from the home position, negative = away from the enemy. evadeFrame: the frame on screen when the dodged strike would have landed (the peak of the hop).
